title: Fix SRD concentration derivation for no-comma concentration durations
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT, Codex, and Fable all found spell:protection-from-evil-and-good has data.duration "Concentration up to 10 minutes" but mechanics.concentration false.
- Fable notes the SRD PDF itself prints "Duration: Concentration up to 10 minutes" with no comma on p. 173; this is a known source typo compared to the usual "Concentration, up to ..." form.
- The text was copied faithfully, but the comma-dependent detector mis-derived the concentration flag.
- Git history comparison showed this was already present before the latest erf5 fixes, so it is not a new erf5 regression.

Why it matters:
- A concentration tracker could allow Protection from Evil and Good to stack with another concentration spell.
- This is a direct source-vs-derived-mechanics accuracy bug.
- Fable says this is the only spell in the pack with the non-standard concentration duration string.

Acceptance criteria:
- spell:protection-from-evil-and-good emits mechanics.concentration true.
- The detector accepts both "Concentration, up to ..." and "Concentration up to ...".
- Add a regression test for the exact no-comma SRD duration form.
- Add a pack-wide gate that compares mechanics.concentration against duration semantics for all 319 spells.
- Confirm no spell with a non-concentration duration starts emitting concentration true.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #383: detector accepts comma and no-comma concentration forms; protection-from-evil-and-good emits concentration true; pack-wide spell-concentration-flag gate added; source typo documented in known-source-typos.md.
